grahaInBhava: .input {$graha :entity kind=graha} .input {$bhava :integer select=ordinal} .match $bhava one {{{$graha} in the {$bhava}st house}} two {{{$graha} in the {$bhava}nd house}} few {{{$graha} in the {$bhava}rd house}} * {{{$graha} in the {$bhava}th house}}
conjunction: .input {$count :integer} .input {$graha :entity kind=graha form=prose} .match $count 0 {{No planet conjoins {$graha}}} one {{One planet conjoins {$graha}}} * {{{$count} planets conjoin {$graha}}}
rashiNature: .input {$rashi :entity kind=rashi} .match $rashi m {{{$rashi} is a masculine sign}} f {{{$rashi} is a feminine sign}} * {{{$rashi} is a sign}}
